regions.summary: ReturnToInventorySelection: Default action rejoins inventory selection. The four-word action directory also selects the two bounded item-consumption handlers below. ConsumeInventoryHealthItem: If counter A is nonzero, consume one item, raise health toward the cap of twenty and redraw the inventory. Yield, sound and delay under task selector four, then rejoin menu selection. Text resource selector $4F must also be four because the drawing helper leaves its selected bank mapped. ConsumeInventoryFlagItem: Require counter B and a clear use flag, consume the item, set the flag and refresh the same inventory display before returning to selection. Item identity remains uncertain; task and text resource selectors are four.

regions.summary: PollControllers: Read eight serial bits from each controller, accepting either low input wire. Store held buttons and derive newly pressed buttons as new&~old. Then update the eight-byte shift-register pseudo-random state. ReadOneController: Strobe the serial controller latch and shift eight sampled bits into scratch. X selects the port; the result updates its held and newly pressed bytes. AdvanceRandomState: XOR bit1 from the first two pseudo-random bytes into carry and rotate through the eight-byte state. This deterministic generator is frame-driven.

regions.summary: ExpandMetatileColumn: Copy four tile IDs from the metatile definition into the two staged20-byte columns, advancing the output index twice. ResolveRoomLayout: Combine scroll direction, camera page and layout offset to resolve the16-byte room layout page pointer; preserve exact high-bit arithmetic. BuildScrollAttributes: When the pending flag requires it, resolve the five-byte attribute record, compute the destination attribute offset and copy its bytes into staging. ResolveAttributeRecord: Multiply a room-layout attribute ID by five and add the attribute-data base to obtain a record pointer. ResolveMetatileDefinition: Multiply the metatile ID by four and add its definition base; the result points to four tile IDs. MultiplyByTwenty: Compute the16-bit product A*20 using saved A*4 plus A*16. Return low byte in A and scratch$40, high byte in scratch$41.

regions.summary: Transform A and arithmetic scratch high:low ($41:$40), then return A=low. With initial a,m=low,h=high, t=((4*a mod256)+m+((a>>6)&1)) mod256; result=4*((h<<8)|t) mod65536. Do not assume a general multiply-by-twenty entry.

Inspected source inventory and residual raw-operand samples; checked native C09C A-to-OAM parameter/shared return, C0BF ordinary/IRQ overlap, AC71 initializer/ACEC directory boundary, E242 five-byte decimal increment format, arithmetic carry contract, and all seven unknown boundary notes against current terminal review. Corrected stale round04/pass-006 source introduction to pass-008 without changing labels, operands, bytes or classification. Existing mechanical role/field/constants/branch/data prose and local uncertainties remain coherent; original resource/item/music/species meanings and natural victory are not asserted. The remaining 16 bytes comprise 15 research-ambiguous bytes and one NES-MAP-002 representation-blocked byte; final editorial acceptance is independent of incomplete ROM classification. Detailed scope/evidence/limits: editorial-audit.md. Official final audit supplies independent fresh byte-identical verification and reading-copy refresh. units.name: StartSoundSequence
units.summary: Start a sequence from A after saving A/X/Y in shared scratch. The single-entry path and consecutive-entry path share initialization; X selects a channel through the word-indexed table.

units.name: InitializeSoundChannel
units.summary: Preserve the channel ownership bit, mark it active, install current/restart stream pointers and clear modulation, delay and return-stack state. Initialize the channel register image, then silence its hardware output before playback.

units.name: SilenceAllSoundChannels
units.summary: Save A/X/Y, clear all nine active channel flags and silence four hardware channels. Restore the saved argument registers through the common suffix.

units.name: SuspendSoundChannels
units.summary: Save A/X/Y, set active bit7 on eight channel records, silence them and clear the ninth record. Reuse the register restoration suffix.

units.name: SuspendSoundWithGate
units.summary: Save A/X/Y, set the sound suspend gate, silence channel eight and clear the high flag on channels seven through zero and refresh hardware only where flag bit six is set. Restore the original registers through the shared suffix. Requires initialized RAM sound store and live stack above $0194; natural caller is unresolved.

units.name: SaveSoundArguments
units.summary: Save the three argument registers in shared zero-page scratch; callers restore only the registers required by their entry contract.

units.name: UpdateSoundChannels
units.summary: Disable frame IRQ through $4017, then scan nine channel records backwards. Process records with active bit7 and without bit6; preserve the scan index across the interpreter.

units.name: UpdateSoundModulation
units.summary: Apply enabled per-channel modulation stages when their low-bit countdown expires. These stages adjust volume/frequency register images before stream timing advances.

units.name: MergeSoundEnvelopePhase
units.summary: After the envelope update, combine its shape low nibble with the channel phase and join command decoding. The nonzero envelope-counter path returns without calls or mapper writes for channel X zero through eight; this local contract does not promise every envelope input returns.

units.name: TickSoundDelay
units.summary: Decrement the event delay, reload its low-nibble interval when expired, and honor the longer note duration before fetching another stream event.

units.name: ReadSoundCommand
units.summary: Read through the channel stream pointer. Values below $E0 enter note decoding; command bytes use a 32-word return-address table and RTS dispatch. Targets are encoded for RTS rather than ordinary JSR.

units.name: SetSoundGateFlag
units.summary: Set the channel bit3 flag and consume the one-byte command. Its exact musical effect is only partly established by later note decoding.

units.name: ClearSoundGateFlag
units.summary: Clear channel flag bit3 and consume the command without an operand; exact articulation meaning is uncertain.

units.name: SetSoundTickInterval
units.summary: Take the operand low nibble as the immediate countdown and as the low half of the packed timing parameter.

units.name: SetSoundDurationScale
units.summary: Replace the low five bits of the packed scale parameter, then derive the channel timing/register representation.

units.name: SetSoundDurationMode
units.summary: Pack the operand low three bits into the high bits of the scale parameter. The lower scale bits survive.

units.name: SetSoundVolumeParameter
units.summary: Store the packed volume/modulation operand and copy its low nibble into the upper timing nibble.

units.name: SetSoundTimingHighNibble
units.summary: Read one operand, shift its low nibble into the upper timing nibble and preserve the existing low timing nibble.

units.name: SetSoundBranchCounter
units.summary: Copy the operand to the per-channel branch counter, then consume opcode and operand.

units.name: ClearSoundBranchCounter
units.summary: Clear the per-channel branch counter and consume only the opcode.

units.name: IncrementSoundBranchCounter
units.summary: Add one modulo16 to the channel branch counter; the adjacent decrement entry supplies minus one to the same update.

units.name: DecrementSoundBranchCounter
units.summary: Subtract one modulo16 through the shared branch-counter update.

units.name: EnableSoundTransposition
units.summary: Retain a nonzero operand or reuse the stored parameter, then set its high bit. The pitch decoder applies this enabled transposition; the original musical naming is uncertain.

units.name: DisableSoundTransposition
units.summary: Clear the transposition enable high bit and consume one command byte.

units.name: EnableSoundVolumeSweep
units.summary: Enable bit0 modulation and seed its countdown from the operand low nibble. The full operand retains the sweep shape/index.

units.name: DisableSoundVolumeSweep
units.summary: Clear modulation bit0 before the shared single-byte stream advance.

units.name: ConsumeSoundByte
units.summary: Advance the stream pointer by one, then immediately interpret the next command. This is a command-chain loop, not a frame wait.

units.name: EnableSoundPitchSlide
units.summary: Set channel flag bit1, store the packed slide operand and seed its low-three-bit countdown before consuming two bytes.

units.name: ConsumeSoundOperand
units.summary: Advance the stream pointer by two for an opcode plus operand, then continue interpreting. The nearby path clears bit1 before using the one-byte advance.

units.name: EnableSoundPitchEnvelope
units.summary: Set modulation bit2, read the packed envelope operand, seed its low-nibble countdown and load a word envelope pointer from the operand high nibble. Consume opcode and operand; initialized RAM store template and channel domain0..8 remain required.

units.name: DisableSoundPitchEnvelope
units.summary: Clear channel flag bit2 and return to command decoding after consuming one byte.

units.name: JumpSoundStream
units.summary: Read the two-byte destination directly into the channel stream pointer and resume decoding there.

units.name: JumpSoundWhenCounterNonzero
units.summary: Jump to the operand pointer when the branch counter is nonzero; otherwise skip the three-byte command.

units.name: JumpSoundWhenCounterZero
units.summary: Use the opposite branch-counter predicate before sharing the stream jump or three-byte skip.

units.name: SetSoundRestartPoint
units.summary: Consume this command, save the resulting stream position as the restart pointer, and continue. The following command handles a nested stream call.

units.name: CallSoundSubstream
units.summary: Save the post-command stream position in a channel return slot and shift the packed return metadata, then load the two-byte substream address. Only classified portions of the bounded stack logic are shown.

units.name: RestartSoundStream
units.summary: Restore the channel restart pointer and fetch its next command.

units.name: ReturnSoundSubstream
units.summary: If no return slot remains, deactivate the channel except its ownership bit and silence/update it. Otherwise restore and clear a saved pointer, unwind packed metadata and resume the interpreter.

units.name: DeriveSoundScale
units.summary: Convert the low-five-bit parameter by repeated doubling and reduction modulo $18. Pack the result into the channel timing/register byte while preserving its other fields.

units.name: DecodeSoundNote
units.summary: Decode duration first. $C0..$CF advances a rest; $D0 and above also marks release and may silence the corresponding hardware channel. Lower values enter pitch conversion.

units.name: PrepareSoundPitch
units.summary: Split the note byte into nibbles; apply the channel mode and optional signed transposition while skipping invalid semitone codes.

units.name: LoadExplicitSoundPeriodLow
units.summary: Copy an inline byte into the period-low image, consume two bytes and join the hardware period update.

units.name: WriteSoundNotePeriod
units.summary: Use a word period table indexed by the pitch nibble and shift by the octave nibble. Store the period, consume the note, update hardware and reload modulation counters. The high period image preserves the non-period bits.

units.name: SilenceSoundChannel
units.summary: Tail-call the channel silencing helper; the adjacent entry adds A to the 16-bit stream pointer.

units.name: AdvanceSoundPointer
units.summary: Add A to the stream low byte and carry into the high byte; preserve X as the channel index.

units.name: DecodeSoundDuration
units.summary: Use the event low bits to choose a packed duration mode. One path multiplies the five-bit scale by a small factor; other classified paths derive delay from packed timing fields. Return the original event in A.

units.name: MarkUnderlyingSoundChannel
units.summary: Channels with index bit2 own/override a lower channel selected by index&3. Mark that underlying record with bit5 and return carry set; ordinary channels return carry clear.

units.name: ReleaseUnderlyingSoundChannel
units.summary: For an overriding channel, clear bit5 in the underlying channel and return its index in X with carry set. Carry clear means no underlying channel.

units.name: ApplySoundVolumeSweep
units.summary: Combine the sweep shape and phase to index signed nibble adjustments. Apply the adjustment to the volume nibble only if the result remains below16, then write the channel output.

units.name: ApplySoundPitchSlide
units.summary: Decode a signed step from the packed slide byte and add it to the low period byte, carrying into the three-bit high period field. Preserve the other register-image bits.

units.name: TickSoundPitchEnvelope
units.summary: Advance an envelope countdown and obtain a packed envelope-table value. Only the classified prefix is available; the later effect/loop is deliberately unresolved.

units.name: ReturnFromEnvelopeCountdown
units.summary: Return after the native nonzero envelope countdown decrements its channel counter. This is the matched subroutine suffix of the supported countdown branch.

units.name: AdvanceSoundEnvelopeState
units.summary: Update packed envelope countdown and phase from the envelope shape table. Low and high nibbles select hold, reload or phase progression, then return or join pitch-slide arithmetic. Channel X is zero through eight; initialized RAM hardware-store template and live stack above $0194 remain required. Original musical envelope naming is uncertain.

units.name: InitializeSoundHardwareChannel
units.summary: Select hardware channel register zero through the RAM-resident store helper and initialize its control registers. The neighboring helpers share channel-register address calculation.

units.name: SilenceSoundHardware
units.summary: Choose the hardware silence value, skip writes when the channel is overridden, and call the RAM store helper. The noise/triangle-like special case is selected by channel index&3.

units.name: WriteSoundControl
units.summary: Write the channel control value through the RAM helper unless bit5 says this channel is overridden.

units.name: WriteSoundLengthRegister
units.summary: Select register3 and emit the high period image with trigger/length bits set.

units.name: WriteSoundPeriod
units.summary: Write the low and high period register images through the RAM helper, unless the channel is overridden.

units.name: SelectSoundHardwareRegister
units.summary: Construct the RAM store operand as (channel&3)*4+Y. Reset copies the four-byte STA $4000 / RTS template from fixed ROM FA8E into RAM0191. Native writers change only its operand; the return contract assumes initialization and a stack above0194.

units.name: UpdatePlayer
units.summary: Initialize the player record if inactive; otherwise tick recovery counters and dispatch movement/action state. Input, collision flags and surface type jointly select the subsequent handlers. Physical bank8 contains only this entry prefix; bank9 continues the same CPU execution window.

units.name: TickPlayerSurfaceAnimation
units.summary: Use an eleven-frame pose and a short countdown while travelling through the narrow vertical transition band; the two direction paths share health-decrement handling.

units.name: FindPlayerTransportActor
units.summary: For surface type5, scan four actor records at stride12 for type$85. Compare world position and step toward the selected record at a frame-divided rate.

units.name: FinishPlayerTransportStep
units.summary: Tick the transport contact countdown, normalize the player height into the supported band, then prioritize recovery, jump/fall and attack state before normal facing updates.

units.name: CheckPlayerContactDamage
units.summary: Gate health loss by recovery, surface and damage state. On damage set recovery timers, choose the normal or special-surface pose, request sound11 and return.

units.name: CheckPlayerActionPress
units.summary: Select press from the newly pressed input byte begins the action path. The other button path starts an attack only when the surface/state gate allows it.

units.name: StartPlayerAttack
units.summary: Set the attack and player-state high bits, seed its timer, request sound$18 and choose the attack pose from the inventory/mode flag.

units.name: StartPlayerJump
units.summary: A newly pressed A-like bit captures direction, clears the ascent accumulator and seeds a32-tick jump countdown. Probe the forward collision state and mark the obstruction flags before returning.

units.name: MergePlayerJumpDirection
units.summary: Copy the two direction bits into the collision/jump flag byte. Without directional input, refresh the player surface state.

units.name: ProbePlayerVerticalInput
units.summary: Probe the input-selected vertical direction, then test dynamic actor contact and the progress-sensitive interaction before moving or preparing a room transition. The second-slot path continues across the physical bank boundary.

units.name: ProbeSecondActorForPlayerUpMove
units.summary: Check the second dynamic slot for a supported blocking type and overlap. A special interaction may change progress; otherwise compare ground heights, adjust player height and choose movement or room transition.

units.name: ProbePlayerDownInput
units.summary: Check the down input bit and call the directional collision wrapper before the shared movement finish.

units.name: FinishPlayerVerticalInput
units.summary: Join the ordinary movement/surface handler; the separate downward-contact continuation checks the second actor and lower room boundary.

units.name: ProbeSecondActorForPlayerDownMove
units.summary: Check both dynamic slots through this second-slot continuation, compare ground heights and adjust player height toward the lower boundary. Enter room transition below the supported height band.

units.name: TransitionPlayerRoom
units.summary: When player and follower share a room, prepare large interaction extents and temporarily substitute the follower height before collision testing. Other rooms enter the room-transition lookup.

units.name: RestoreFollowerTransitionExtents
units.summary: Restore follower Y and half-extents after the transition overlap probe while preserving carry. On clear, save the exit selector and enter the player room-exit search.

units.name: ResetFollowerAfterRoomExit
units.summary: After the room-exit scan, pass the follower exit selector to the follower-specific wrapper, select pose $10, clear follower interaction state and choose ground/current height $8E or $62. Task selector is four; a no-match scan provides an ordinary bank-preserving return, without a universal exit-return claim.

units.name: RequestPlayerRoomTransition
units.summary: Pass the saved direction/exit selector to the fixed-bank room transition helper.

units.name: ClearFollowerInteractionAfterExit
units.summary: Clear follower interaction state and return after the second exit scan. The local no-match room-scan contract returns normally under task selector four.

units.name: GatePlayerHorizontalMove
units.summary: Certain surface types2/3 return without ordinary horizontal movement; all other supported types reach the input-driven step.

units.name: MovePlayerFromInput
units.summary: Install horizontal collision extents, choose direction from input bits0/1, and probe tiles. Actor contacts at offsets$18/$24 can block the step; accepted motion uses the shared world-coordinate step routine.

units.name: ProbePlayerActorContacts
units.summary: Scan both dynamic actor slots for supported high-bit types, compare overlap/direction and run the type9B progress interaction when eligible. The resulting progress flag chooses whether movement remains blocked.

units.name: ComparePlayerContactDirection
units.summary: When an actor was found, compare world-coordinate page and low byte, then compare that ordering with the requested step direction.

units.name: CommitPlayerStep
units.summary: Apply one horizontal unit, refresh surface state, and choose the animation. Surface6 can also use the current horizontal input to force a step.

units.name: InitializePlayer
units.summary: Activate the player, copy the stored spawn position, install collision extents and clear action/recovery state. Refresh the surface and join the animation handler.

units.name: UpdatePlayerRecovery
units.summary: Tick recovery/action countdowns, alternate poses at a frame-divided rate and establish a120-tick recovery window when appropriate. The following jump path integrates height from a shrinking countdown.

units.name: UpdatePlayerJump
units.summary: Integrate vertical delta from jump countdown/ascent, derive facing-sensitive horizontal drift and test support. Search a bounded set of landing heights; on success save ground height, clear jump state and seed recovery/pose timers.

units.name: ResetPlayerPoseState
units.summary: Select player pose eight and clear the two player movement-state bytes. This complete mechanical initializer does not establish its original natural entry.

units.name: UpdatePlayerFall
units.summary: Request a sound at the initial32-tick state, integrate height during descent and use saved ground height for landing tests. Direction flags decide whether to apply one horizontal unit.

units.name: StepPlayerDuringFall
units.summary: Convert facing bit6 to the shared direction convention and move one unit.

units.name: ProbePlayerAhead
units.summary: Save world X, offset it by32 in the facing direction, perform directional and actor probes, set obstruction bit7 when blocked, then restore the exact original world position.

units.name: UpdatePlayerAttackPose
units.summary: Tick the attack countdown, choose timed poses depending on the mode flag, then clear the attack state and restore the neutral pose.

units.name: UpdatePlayerFacing
units.summary: Convert the two horizontal input bits into facing bit6 and the associated state byte; avoid rewriting a direction already selected.

units.name: StepActorWorldX
units.summary: A low bit chooses increment/decrement; Y is the number of units and X the12-byte actor offset. Carry/borrow propagates between low world X and its page. The player path also requests camera movement near screen thresholds$50/$B0.

units.name: RefreshPlayerSurface
units.summary: Find a supporting object, normalize its type to seven bits, choose a pose for special surface types and update contact state. With no support, clear the surface type and restore neutral pose only outside action states.

units.name: SelectPlayerWalkPose
units.summary: Use frame bits3/4 as a small animation phase, augment it for non-ground surface types and the mode flag, and write the player pose.

units.name: CheckEpisodeOneFollowerProgress
units.summary: Only episode0 at progress6 sets the follower scripted high bit, clears its action counter and invokes the episode event helper.

units.name: UpdateFollower
units.summary: Initialize the follower if inactive; otherwise refresh supporting-object state and prioritize recovery, jump/fall and scripted movement. The follower is the second12-byte actor record.

units.name: DispatchFollowerState
units.summary: Tick its recovery timer, normalize height toward the saved ground level and dispatch the high-bit state flags. Room mismatch and pseudo-random bits select tentative following behavior.

units.name: StartFollowerRecovery
units.summary: If the contact state permits, seed recovery timers/pose and request sound$11. Exact game event triggering this state remains uncertain.

units.name: CheckFollowerInteractions
units.summary: When active, probe both dynamic actor slots and the player, using state bits to select chase/contact behavior. Only classified continuations are represented.

units.name: ApplyFirstFollowerInteractionResult
units.summary: On ordinary interaction return, test carry, set follower flag $80 when appropriate and shift the result before joining follower state processing. Some interaction handlers deliberately remove their return pair and bypass this continuation.

units.name: ApplySecondFollowerInteractionResult
units.summary: Process the second ordinary interaction result, setting follower flag $40 as required before the next state branch. Return-pair-removing handlers are a separate path; no universal interaction return is assumed.

units.name: MoveFollower
units.summary: At a frame-divided rate refresh surface contact, update facing and install movement extents. Direction bit0 selects the horizontal helper, followed by vertical adjustment and animation.

units.name: StepFollowerRight
units.summary: Probe the right edge, compare against room-derived bounds and advance low world X with carry. A special contact condition toggles direction instead.

units.name: StepFollowerLeft
units.summary: Probe the left edge, count movement delay and decrement world X with borrow when allowed. At the room edge a transport/contact condition reverses the decision direction instead.

units.name: AdjustFollowerHeight
units.summary: Use surface type, player ground height and a periodic target to decide vertical movement. Probe tiles/actor surfaces before updating current and saved height, and tick the surface grace countdown.

units.name: ProbeFollowerBelow
units.summary: Check both dynamic actor slots at their saved world coordinates against the follower height. If no blocking contact remains, move the follower height one unit.

units.name: TickFollowerSurfaceGrace
units.summary: Count down an eight-tick grace period; when it expires with no surface, enter the follower fall initializer.

units.name: RefreshFollowerSurface
units.summary: Only test the player room; query supporting objects and preserve their low-seven-bit type. Choose follower pose$10/$19 and invoke the shared contact helper when the record carries a nonzero subtype.

units.name: SelectFollowerWalkPose
units.summary: Derive a four-phase animation from frame bits3/4, adjust for surface type and store the second actor pose.

units.name: NudgeFollowerTowardPlayer
units.summary: When saved ground heights agree within one unit, compare world X and use a five-unit correction in the selected direction. Other vertical differences return without correction.

units.name: StartFollowerFall
units.summary: Choose a vertical correction from ground height, mark the falling flag, seed countdown$20 and clear its accumulator before updating facing.

units.name: InitializeFollower
units.summary: Activate the second actor, install its initial screen/world coordinates, collision extents and neutral pose, and clear recovery/action/contact state. The neighboring recovery path uses timed pose changes.

units.name: UpdateFollowerRecovery
units.summary: Tick its two recovery countdowns; establish high-bit recovery state and120-tick cooldown on completion, alternating pose at an eight-frame cadence.

units.name: UpdateFollowerJump
units.summary: Integrate ascent and facing-sensitive drift, then search bounded landing candidates. On landing save ground height, clear jump state and restore pose/timers; do not infer a natural trigger from this mechanical handler.

units.name: UpdateFollowerFall
units.summary: Tick the32-count fall state, request its initial sound when visible, integrate descent and test ground height with the actor-specific collision wrapper.

units.name: StepFollowerDuringFall
units.summary: Convert facing to direction and apply a single horizontal unit through the common actor step routine.

units.name: UpdateFollowerFacing
units.summary: Compare the follower world position with the player and flip facing bit6 only when the selected following direction changes.

units.name: MeasureFollowerPlayerProximity
units.summary: Temporarily substitute player ground height and several follower bounding extents, preserving/restoring player height. Nested overlap tests accumulate proximity flags in the follower decision byte.

units.name: CompareFollowerWorldX
units.summary: Compare page first, then low world X with actor X. Return the comparison flags; a differing page returns immediately.

units.name: MoveFollowerAwayFromContact
units.summary: Offset follower world X and install narrow extents before the shared follower-room tile probe. The surrounding interaction preserves its comparison state.

units.name: UpdateFollowerScriptedRise
units.summary: Move height toward$20 at a divided frame rate and alternate pose; on countdown completion clear the scripted flag and move eight units in the derived direction.

units.name: SynchronizeFollowerRoom
units.summary: Set follower room to player room, copy player height into current/ground height and probe player overlap. Continue through the classified room-boundary movement and resource synchronization path.

units.name: MoveFollowerThroughRoomBoundary
units.summary: Choose an alternating walk pose, compare follower/player world X, clamp against room edge margins and move3 or16 world units according to visibility. When the transition finishes, clear follower script/contact state and copy the player room resource pointers.

units.name: ReadFollowerRoomBound
units.summary: Use episode and follower room to select a four-byte room descriptor and return its first field.

units.name: DispatchActorInteraction
units.summary: Double A to index a37-word directory and reject indices at or above$4A. Tail-dispatch the selected interaction body. Most return carry; the attachment/movement handlers explicitly discard one stacked return pair before returning to their outer caller.

units.name: AttachFollowerToInteractionActor
units.summary: Move follower Y toward the selected actor and face it. Approach an eight-unit world-X separation, then set scripted interaction state and timers. Discard the interaction caller return pair so control resumes at its outer caller.

units.name: StartFollowerContactDirection
units.summary: If the follower contact flag is negative, derive a direction against actor Y, set decision/interaction flags and return carry clear. Otherwise return carry set.

units.name: MoveFollowerRelativeToPlayer
units.summary: Correct follower ground height into its supported band and move toward the player with a16-unit world-X margin. Direction controls facing and collision probes. Discard one return pair at completion; this is not an ordinary bank-preserving leaf.

units.name: ProbeFollowerWideInteraction
units.summary: Temporarily enlarge follower extents to48/48, test overlap and restore2/6 without disturbing carry. A rare random/contact condition reverses its decision direction; return carry set only for the blocked branch.

units.name: RunInventoryMenu
units.summary: New Select input enters the menu, disables normal dialog work and sets PPU text source selector4F=4. Yield while updating the menu and restore the ordinary display on exit. Task selector4 is the low-bank continuation contract.

units.name: YieldInventoryFrame
units.summary: Yield and process menu selection. Selection zero draws the episode map and event/world markers, waits for an exit button and restores menu resources. Other selections indirect-dispatch through the owned-item table.

units.name: ReturnToInventorySelection
units.summary: Default action rejoins inventory selection. The four-word action directory also selects the two bounded item-consumption handlers below.

units.name: ConsumeInventoryHealthItem
units.summary: If counter A is nonzero, consume one item, raise health toward the cap of twenty and redraw the inventory. Yield, sound and delay under task selector four, then rejoin menu selection. Text resource selector $4F must also be four because the drawing helper leaves its selected bank mapped.

units.name: ConsumeInventoryFlagItem
units.summary: Require counter B and a clear use flag, consume the item, set the flag and refresh the same inventory display before returning to selection. Item identity remains uncertain; task and text resource selectors are four.

units.name: DrawInventoryMenu
units.summary: Queue the initial menu background, yield twice and populate item rows. The digit helper clamps displayed quantities to9 and maps them to tile codes starting$DA.

units.name: DrawInventoryItems
units.summary: Append owned item rows, recording their item identifiers in the compact selection list. Episode-specific text is scanned until$FF; other high-bit bytes delimit item groups.

units.name: DrawEpisodeInventoryText
units.summary: Resolve the episode item text stream, scan delimited groups and queue the selected packed PPU records. Adjust destination by rows and use the 4F=4 address-specific text helper for the terminal prompt.

units.name: ClearInventoryRows
units.summary: Build nine queued PPU rows of24 zero bytes, starting at$2288 and advancing by$20 after each frame yield. The queue record length field is count-minus-one.

units.name: UpdateInventorySelection
units.summary: Use new up/down presses to adjust selection, wrap it to the current owned-item count and derive a pointer for the cursor sprite.

units.name: DrawInventoryCursor
units.summary: Select the cursor coordinates from a word table, then draw one sprite using the fixed sprite helper with tile/attribute data supplied by a local pointer.

units.name: DrawInventoryEventMarkers
units.summary: Scan four persistent event flags. For each present flag select episode coordinates, offset them to menu space and draw its four-byte sprite record through the indexed allocator.

units.name: DrawInventoryEventMarker
units.summary: Resolve one episode/event coordinate pair and sprite record, then draw it in the inventory display. The event index is supplied in the shared UI iterator.

units.name: RunTitleSequence
units.summary: Initialize graphics/palette and display timed title/character screens. Input can shorten waits; the six-screen loop changes sprite/text selection and palette fades. Natural title entry was observed; this is not an ending proof.

units.name: AdvanceTitlePresentation
units.summary: Fade the first display out, then cycle six panels with a180-frame wait or input, restoring drawing/palette state around each panel.

units.name: FinishTitlePanel
units.summary: After the wait counter expires, fade the panel, wait32 frames and advance the bounded six-panel index.

units.name: DrawTitleCharacter
units.summary: Select bank4 and sprite resource base$90E0, initialize sprite allocator state and draw the indexed character at supplied screen coordinates. The adjacent entry queues indexed title text.

units.name: UpdateTitleChoiceCursor
units.summary: Toggle the two-choice title index on new direction input, request navigation sound and draw the cursor at its indexed coordinate pair.

units.name: QueueEpisodeClearGraphics
units.summary: Select deferred resource bank4, index episode-specific transfer selectors and load the selected tile-transfer list. Further accepted continuation follows the same bounded presentation loop.

units.name: FinishEpisodeClearPresentation
units.summary: Wait60 frames, fade out, disable rendering and clear the actor byte range before returning to the scene caller.

units.name: PresentEpisodeOneClearDialog
units.summary: Alternate two character portraits and dialog windows through message IDs33..38, with a shared text transfer and timed pause; finish through common episode-clear cleanup.

units.name: PresentEpisodeTwoClearDialog
units.summary: Alternate portraits and blocking messages3A..41, including the shared text transfer, then join common presentation cleanup. These are presentation selectors, not proof of natural victory.

units.name: PresentEpisodeThreeClearDialog
units.summary: Queue several timed rectangular transfers while alternating portraits and messages43..4A. Reuse the common fade/actor cleanup.

units.name: PresentEpisodeFourClearDialog
units.summary: Alternate portraits and messages4C..54 with a shared text transfer and timed final pause, then join common cleanup.

units.name: DrawClearDialogRightPortrait
units.summary: Preserve the portrait selector, select resource bank4 and draw it at the right-side coordinates. Initialize sprite allocation and yield one frame; the caller uses task selector4.

units.name: DrawClearDialogLeftPortrait
units.summary: Select bank4 and draw the supplied portrait at the left-side coordinates with its local offsets, then yield one frame under task selector4.

units.name: QueueClearDialogTextTransfer
units.summary: Yield until blocking dialog clears, resolve the episode text pointer and schedule a rectangular PPU transfer with two four-frame waits.

units.name: DrawInventoryWorldMarkers
units.summary: Convert follower and player room/world positions into separate map markers and draw each at its allocated sprite slot.

units.name: ProjectWorldPositionToInventory
units.summary: Divide the supplied world coordinate by16, select the episode room coordinate list and offset the point into the inventory display. A negative room entry moves the marker off screen.

units.name: InitializeRoomActorRecords
units.summary: Resolve episode and room word directories, then install at most four seven-byte records at actor offset48..84. Fields are world-X page, world-X low, height, half-height, half-width, type flags and active flags. OR flag fields into existing records, force active/type high bits and poseFF, and stop on a negative first byte. The native bank5 caller establishes physical banks10/11; no calls, pushes or mapper writes occur. ACEC begins the retained directory.

units.name: CullRoomActorRecords
units.summary: Visit four room actor records at stride12. An active record with a nonzero world-X page is cleared when its screen X lies in the central30..CF band; exact gameplay reason for this culling rule is uncertain.

units.name: TestRoomActorCull
units.summary: Reject a record on world-X page zero or one outside the central screen band; otherwise clear all twelve bytes of that record.

units.name: ClearRoomActorRecord
units.summary: Clear the complete twelve-byte room actor record indexed by Y. This is distinct from only clearing an actor active flag.

units.name: EncodePasswordState
units.summary: Clear the encoding workspace, pack six persistent state fields into nibbles, accumulate a weighted checksum, derive a mixing seed and transform the result for display. Exact original password naming is inferred from the visible eight-character consumer.

units.name: PackPasswordStateBits
units.summary: Use the per-field bit counts to rotate state bits into the packed password nibbles. Keep the field index and bit count in scratch; zero count entries advance to the next layout field.

units.name: AccumulatePasswordChecksum
units.summary: Visit six packed nibbles and add each value times its position-dependent weight to a16-bit checksum in scratch18/19.

units.name: AddWeightedPasswordNibble
units.summary: Multiply A by10+X with repeated16-bit addition, then add the product to the checksum. Preserve the nibble and weight in scratch during the loop.

units.name: MixPasswordNibbles
units.summary: Advance the feedback seed and add its output to each packed nibble modulo16. The accepted continuation preserves the exact original loop bounds.

units.name: UnmixPasswordNibbles
units.summary: Advance the same feedback seed and subtract its output modulo16 from six packed nibbles in reverse order.

units.name: AdvancePasswordMixingSeed
units.summary: Apply two rounds of carry-dependent rotates/XOR feedback to the byte seed in scratch1E. Return the resulting byte; the transform is deterministic rather than a cryptographic claim.

units.name: DecodePasswordState
units.summary: Check the special password form first. Otherwise seed and reverse nibble mixing, validate the weighted checksum and unpack the six fields. Carry set rejects the entered code; the special form returns its nonzero selector.

units.name: CheckPasswordChecksum
units.summary: Recompute the weighted checksum and compare its selected low and shifted nibbles against the encoded checksum fields. Return carry clear only when both match.

units.name: UnpackPasswordStateBits
units.summary: Reverse the encoder bit layout using the nonzero field-width controls. Rotate bits from the packed nibbles into six output fields; skip zero control entries and preserve the partial byte across layout changes.

units.name: MatchSpecialPassword
units.summary: Compare entered values against a small FF-delimited sequence table, tracking the matched sequence number. On a match validate the following value as a selector below8; exact special-mode meaning remains uncertain.

units.name: ReadSpecialPasswordSelector
units.summary: Accept the following entered value only below8 and store it as the special selector; carry conveys acceptance to the caller.

units.name: DrawPasswordState
units.summary: Copy episode and five persistent progress fields into the encoder input, encode them and queue eight tiles at consecutive PPU cells. Add$C0 to each nibble to obtain the displayed character tile.

units.name: RunPasswordInput
units.summary: Clear eight input nibbles and draw them. New horizontal input selects a digit modulo8, vertical input changes it modulo16 and high button bits submit. Invalid input shows a timed replacement row; valid input installs episode/progress and clears the UI scratch region.

units.name: DrawPasswordInputDigit
units.summary: Convert the selected nibble to tileC0..CF and queue it at its password cell. Set task selector5 before yielding so the bank5 UI resumes correctly.

units.name: SubmitPasswordInput
units.summary: Copy eight edited nibbles into the decoder workspace, retry on carry-set failure, or install decoded episode and five progress fields and return.

units.name: ShowInvalidPasswordRow
units.summary: Configure an eight-cell replacement row in resource bank5 and wait90 frames before returning to input. Its exact displayed wording is retained as local tile data.

units.name: UpdateActorSpawning
units.summary: Spawn only when camera movement is requested. Tick the random spawn cooldown, otherwise use episode/room and a64-pixel world column to select a spawn type; a separate cooldown prevents repeated column spawning.

units.name: SetActorSpawnGate
units.summary: Set the actor spawn gate after the slot initializer returns and join the native update. Both dynamic slots occupied provide a concrete ordinary return; arbitrary initialization callbacks are outside this local contract.

units.name: AllocateDynamicActor
units.summary: Search the two actor slots at offsets$18/$24, activate a free one and choose its height from pseudo-random state. Place it ahead of the camera according to scroll direction, then install type-specific fields.

units.name: ChooseActorSpawnSide
units.summary: Camera direction or a random bit chooses the side. Right-side world coordinates add$110 to camera position; left-side coordinates subtract$10. Out-of-range records are cleared.

units.name: InitializeSpawnedActor
units.summary: Use the type as a four-byte descriptor index for extents, sprite descriptor and pose, OR its type into the record and clear its12-byte auxiliary state. Reject a spawn that overlaps supporting objects/tiles; accepted spawns seed the next cooldown.

units.name: CheckRoomActorTriggers
units.summary: On camera movement at a16-pixel boundary, compute the newly exposed world column and scan four-byte episode trigger records. A separate activation bitmap prevents repeated triggers; high-bit record tags terminate the list.

units.name: ClampRoomTriggerColumn
units.summary: Subtract one column on the left-moving path, clamping underflow to zero, then scan the selected trigger list.

units.name: MatchRoomActorColumn
units.summary: Match the trigger column, call the actor activation helper, increment the four-byte record index and continue scanning to its terminator. The activation entry and accepted setup fragments are named separately.

units.name: ActivateRoomActorTrigger
units.summary: Select the follower-related slot, reject an active record and read the matching four-byte room trigger. Preserve its tag and mask existing type flags before the previously reviewed setup continuation.

units.name: CheckColumnObjectTriggers
units.summary: On16-pixel camera movement, select an episode/room list and compute the exposed column. Scan three-byte records to$FF, invoking the activation helper only for a matching column.

units.name: ClampObjectTriggerColumn
units.summary: Clamp the left-edge column calculation, then initialize the three-byte-record scan.

units.name: MatchObjectTriggerColumn
units.summary: Compare a candidate column, call its activation helper on equality and advance the record index. The$FF terminator returns.

units.name: ActivateColumnObjectTrigger
units.summary: Find a free dynamic actor slot at stride12, then read the matching column record and merge its type bits into the actor. Return immediately when both dynamic slots are occupied.

units.name: RestoreActorCallerTaskSelector
units.summary: Pop the caller task selector saved before the actor update, store it back to $85 and return. This cleanup restores the saved value; it does not itself remap the lower window or promise every actor callback preserves it.

units.name: CompareActorWorldX
units.summary: Normalize selector$10 to follower offset$0C, compare high world X first and then low world X. The result remains in processor flags.

units.name: MeasureActorWorldDistance
units.summary: Normalize selector$10 to follower offset12, load two16-bit world-X positions and return their absolute difference in scratch18/19. This mechanical distance is shared by several actor handlers.

units.name: SubtractActorWorldX
units.summary: Subtract A from actor low world X with borrow into its page. Preserve the caller scratch byte through Y and return A=0.

units.name: AddActorWorldX
units.summary: Add A to actor low world X with carry into its page and return through the existing scratch-preserving suffix.

units.name: ProbeActorAgainstPlayerAttack
units.summary: Require player pose$0F, then temporarily shift the actor by its sprite/height offset before the shared overlap test. Restore all modified fields and return the contact carry.

units.name: ProbeActorOffsetRectangle
units.summary: Build a facing-relative rectangle from scratch offsets, temporarily narrow the target actor and shift its height, test overlap and restore every stacked field. Carry is the overlap result.

units.name: ProbePlayerAttackAgainstActor
units.summary: Gate on the player action mode, offset its screen X by facing and Y by24, narrow the attack extents and temporarily adjust the target actor. Shared suffix restores every stacked field and returns collision carry.

units.name: ProbeActorUpperContact
units.summary: Temporarily move the other actor up15 and replace its extents with15/8, perform overlap and restore every field. Neighboring helpers compare saved ground-height distance and test supporting-object type$86.

units.name: CompareActorGroundHeight
units.summary: Return the absolute difference of the actors saved ground heights compared with the input threshold.

units.name: TestActorSupportType
units.summary: Query support under the actor; return its type comparison against$86 on success, or A=1 on failure.

units.name: ProbeActorForwardWithExtents
units.summary: Save actor Y/extents and caller Y, substitute ground height and scratch-supplied extents, choose the probe direction from facing, then restore all saved fields. Return the tile result in carry.

units.name: DivideSignedMotionDelta
units.summary: Compute a signed quotient using repeated addition/subtraction with the positive divisor in Y. Return the truncated quotient in A; scratch18 retains the working remainder. Callers supply nonzero bounded divisors.

units.name: UpdateDelayedActorMotion
units.summary: Initialize auxiliary state once, then choose the normal countdown or negative alternate mode. Timer expiry feeds the existing movement/contact logic; exact actor identity is unresolved.

units.name: UpdateVerticalPatrolActor
units.summary: Initialize its auxiliary fields, then gate on animation timing and use alternate-mode bit0 to increment or decrement Y. The terminal phase rises by2 and steps horizontally by2 according to facing.

units.name: UpdateDynamicActorMotion
units.summary: Initialize a target player/follower index and random height on first use; choose facing from world ordering. Later states use timed motion, attack/contact tests and a table-driven vertical phase. Exact actor species remains unresolved.

units.name: DispatchDynamicActorMotion
units.summary: Return immediately at the shared entry. The delay subentry chooses a distance threshold from the auxiliary mode, measures target/player separation and seeds motion delay before sound and timed side-step processing.

units.name: TickDynamicActorDelay
units.summary: Move the special-mode actor through the side-step helper and decrement its delay.

units.name: SetDynamicActorSpecialMode
units.summary: Set auxiliary bit7 before joining the special movement path.

units.name: MoveDynamicActorByPhase
units.summary: Select special/alternate motion from auxiliary flags; otherwise advance an eight-frame indexed signed-height table. Values$04/$FC increase horizontal step, $80 selects a pause, and zero resets the phase.

units.name: ApplyDynamicActorPhase
units.summary: Add the signed phase delta to height, move horizontally according to facing and test support and forward obstruction. Obstruction can enter the special state or reverse facing.

units.name: ProbeDynamicActorSupport
units.summary: Temporarily change probe extents, query supporting surfaces and clear an unsupported actor record. The forward probe uses ground height and separately restored extents.

units.name: ReverseDynamicActorFacing
units.summary: Toggle bit6 of the actor attribute/facing byte before the shared contact processing.

units.name: ResetDynamicActorPhase
units.summary: Reset the auxiliary phase counter when the motion table returns zero.

units.name: CheckDynamicActorCharacters
units.summary: Test saved-ground-height proximity to player and follower; facing agreement plus upper-body overlap sets their contact high bit. Walk pose toggles every16 ticks and a rare random state requests sound$1F.

units.name: AdvanceDynamicActorAnimation
units.summary: Process both character targets, tick the animation counter, toggle pose at16-tick intervals and occasionally request a sound.

units.name: TickDynamicActorAlternateMode
units.summary: Advance the alternate timer: first move horizontally and rise, then return toward saved ground height. At46 set the landing pose, toggle it every eight ticks and at80 restore facing and clear motion/alternate state.

units.name: StepDynamicActorSpecialMode
units.summary: Move two world units by facing while the special phase rises by2 below90, pauses through94 and descends by2 untilA4. Increment phase each update and clear it atA5 before joining shared animation.

units.name: UpdateActorApproachAndLunge
units.summary: Initialize a visible character target, clamp ground height and choose facing. Approach by two units, start a short table-driven lunge within37 world units, test both characters and enter timed recoil or turn recovery on collision. Auxiliary fields hold target, phase, saved height, pose masks and recovery timers.

units.name: AdvanceActorFirstMotionPhase
units.summary: Tick motion phase, seed first-use pose parameters and select pose masks from a three-byte table. Run the shared target approach/lunge/recovery helper; species remains unresolved.

units.name: AdvanceActorSecondMotionPhase
units.summary: Tick phase, seed alternate pose/mask parameters and change them during the shared recovery timer. Call the same approach/lunge helper with this handler-specific animation setup.

units.name: UpdateActorProximityCountdown
units.summary: Choose player/follower target at initialization, measure world-X distance and wait until it is below32 on the same page. Store that distance as a countdown, then advance the actor mode/phase through its existing contact continuation.

units.name: UpdateActorProximityAnimation
units.summary: Initialize facing from world ordering, tick animation and reuse the proximity countdown helper. A separate auxiliary counter supplies an eight-tick animation phase. Species/visual identity remains uncertain.

units.name: UpdatePairedActorPose
units.summary: Deactivate if the two dynamic type IDs match; otherwise initialize state and switch to pose$22 at contact-state1, then join shared timed animation.

units.name: UpdatePairedActorContact
units.summary: Use the paired-type mismatch gate, initialize auxiliary state and advance contact state1 before shared timed animation. Keep the actor species unspecified.

units.name: UpdatePairedActorAlternate
units.summary: Apply the same paired-type gate, initialize its alternate parameters and advance contact state1 before the shared animation helper.

units.name: TickActorAuxiliaryPhase
units.summary: Advance phase on an actor/frame parity gate, dispatch recovery or retreat modes and otherwise track the selected character. Shared body uses height threshold tables, distance/facing gates, attack overlap and room-support tests.

units.name: TrackPairedActorTarget
units.summary: Count down target-facing refresh, approach the target ground height using threshold/step tables and clamp to61..8E. Distance and facing choose walking versus contact poses; shared collision code can enter recovery or retreat.

units.name: ProbePairedActorContacts
units.summary: Probe the player attack and both character bodies. A hit seeds the retreat mode and facing; the active contact pose can mark a character contact flag using an enlarged rectangle.

units.name: RetreatPairedActor
units.summary: Move three world units by facing, adjust height near the follower and alternate poses. Shared support/room-edge tests decide reversal, removal or a timed jump/recovery state.

units.name: CheckPairedActorSupport
units.summary: Use narrow support and directional probes to distinguish unsupported removal, room-edge reversal and a recoverable obstruction. Restore ordinary extents before returning.

units.name: AnimatePairedActorRecovery
units.summary: Advance a timed recovery: delay, move two units, change pose and sound, rise then descend in five-unit steps and reset at saved ground height. A negative recovery mode uses the separate moving retreat path.

units.name: MovePairedActorRecovery
units.summary: Advance negative recovery mode and move one or three world units according to retreat state before rejoining character or support checks.

units.name: UpdateRandomHeightActor
units.summary: Seed Y from random bits in the range$68..$87, then use an auxiliary animation/movement phase. On return mode, move down toward saved ground Y and seed the finishing pose/delay.

units.name: UpdateActorTimedMotion
units.summary: Initialize auxiliary state once, then increment the motion phase and use the existing timed movement/contact body. Exact actor identity is unresolved; the field mechanics are explicit below.

units.name: InitializeActorShortRandomMode
units.summary: Seed the short-mode animation masks, sound and collision parameters, choose mode0/1 and call the shared bounded patrol body.

units.name: InitializeActorLongRandomMode
units.summary: On first use seed animation, sound, collision and timing parameters; choose random movement mode1/2, then call the shared bounded patrol body. This configuration differs from the short-mode handler.

units.name: UpdateActorBoundedPatrol
units.summary: Initialize random height6A..89 and facing. Oscillate within64..8C, toggle poses and sound by masks, move with directional/support probes and reverse with a short delay on obstruction. Mark either character on overlap; callers provide the mode-specific speed, masks and extents.

units.name: UpdateActorSelectedTarget
units.summary: Choose player or follower offset at initialization, save it in auxiliary target state and increment motion phase thereafter. Random target choice is gated by follower visibility.

units.name: AdvanceActorThirdMotionPhase
units.summary: Tick phase and enter the follower-relative motion body across physical banks12/13. Its vertical alignment, horizontal approach, support rollback and timed rise/fall states remain mechanically named without a species claim.

units.name: ContinueActorThirdMotionPhase
units.summary: Continue the actor motion handler across the physical8KiB boundary within the same bank6 CPU window. Actor state and proximity select the timing, movement and contact paths; exact actor identity is unresolved.

units.name: TickActorAnimationPhase
units.summary: Initialize a character target and facing, periodically refresh it and switch between idle pose cycling, approach, contact recoil and support rollback. Auxiliary fields retain timers, original world position and facing for each path.

units.name: UpdateActorHorizontalContact
units.summary: Run the fixed horizontal oscillation gate, seed pose/sound parameters and advance the shared approach/contact state machine. At auxiliary state10 invoke progress8 replacement; exact actor identity is unresolved.

units.name: UpdateAlternateActorHorizontalContact
units.summary: Use the same horizontal gate with alternate timing/pose parameters. Advance the shared approach/contact state machine and invoke progress4 replacement at auxiliary state10.

units.name: UpdateActorVerticalContact
units.summary: Run the vertical oscillation gate, initialize facing/poses and call the approach gate under its supported partial-return premise. Timed facing/pose changes and player contact enter a recoil cycle; terminal movement approaches the episode point before replacement dispatch.

units.name: GateActorVerticalContact
units.summary: Skip the oscillation gate during negative animation phase, then use alternate approach/attack poses. Progress11/12 permits a player-contact recoil with timed lateral movement, sound and eventual progress11 replacement. A9F5 has only a supported local partial-return contract.

units.name: UpdateActorApproachGate
units.summary: Gate approach on auxiliary state and phase parity, then choose vertical alignment, short horizontal approach or a facing/pose refresh. The supported nonnegative state and odd phase reaches AA59 before any push. Deeper paths have local saved-coordinate contracts; this is not a universal ordinary-return guarantee.

units.name: AlignActorGroundHeight
units.summary: Choose a divisor from height distance, try a signed step toward player ground height with narrow extents, and preserve or restore the trial height according to tile support. Scratch1F=FF reports already aligned within three units.

units.name: ApproachPlayerWithRollback
units.summary: Derive a bounded horizontal step from screen distance, save world coordinates and probe the trial position. Keep the move only when the forward/support helper allows it; otherwise restore the saved position.

units.name: MoveActorToEpisodePoint
units.summary: Choose an episode coordinate pair, with an alternate point for the lower half of episode4. Move height proportionally and world X by one while animating; scratch1F becomes nonzero only within the target tolerances.

units.name: ProbeActorStepSupport
units.summary: Save extents, install a narrow forward rectangle and call directional/support probes. Store zero in the auxiliary result when the step is clear and one when blocked, then restore extents.

units.name: InitializeEpisodeIntroActors
units.summary: Resolve one of four episode actor lists and copy four-byte height/screen-X/pose/flags records into actor slots at stride12 untilFF. Set active/type flags, enable rendering and indirect-dispatch the episode intro script.

units.name: EnableIntroRendering
units.summary: Call the shared rendering-enable helper after the actor setup loop reaches its terminator.

units.name: WaitForIntroCleanup
units.summary: Wait60 frame yields through the common helper. This entry was exercised with an artificial caller/stack contract; it does not establish natural intro completion.

units.name: RunEpisodeOneIntro
units.summary: Request message32 and join the shared fade and actor cleanup. This presentation contract does not establish natural selection.

units.name: JoinEpisodeIntroCleanup
units.summary: Tail-jump to the shared timed cleanup path.

units.name: RunEpisodeTwoIntro
units.summary: Yield and animate follower while moving its screen X left to87, request message39 and join shared cleanup.

units.name: RunEpisodeThreeIntro
units.summary: Request message42 and join shared cleanup.

units.name: RequestEpisodeThreeMessage
units.summary: Request message4B, then animate the follower moving right toFD, hide it, wait30 frames and request messageBD before the following return presentation.

units.name: WaitEpisodeFourIntro
units.summary: Wait30 frames, show and face the follower, animate its move left to7F and join shared cleanup. This statically supported script is separate from proof of natural entry.

units.name: AnimateIntroFollowerPose
units.summary: Derive a four-phase pose index from the frame counter and write the follower pose from a four-byte table.

units.name: RunCreditsSoundSelection
units.summary: Fade/clear the display and sound, set PPU text source selector4F to6, draw the credits stream and enable rendering. On each high-button press silence sound, advance through ID/count pairs, play the selection and update its digit; wrap at the negative sentinel. Natural entry is not established by this contract.

units.name: DelayCpuLoop
units.summary: Burn a bounded register-controlled CPU delay. X is the outer count; Y runs short inner loops, with a parity-dependent timing adjustment.

units.name: YieldFrame
units.summary: Preserve A/X/Y, wait for the relevant display phase, select the sprite-resource bank, build/sort/draw the actor sprite list, then switch to sound bank3. The frame helper and NMI cooperate through a frame-ready flag; mapper selection is by bus-conflict-safe table reads/writes.

units.name: SynchronizeSpriteZeroSplit
units.summary: Run the periodic UI update, then use palette/split flags to choose a fixed delay or wait for sprite-zero hit. Restore scroll/PPU control for the split region.

units.name: SetSplitScroll
units.summary: Set the split PPU address/control state and clear the nametable selector bits in the shadow control byte.

units.name: SelectSoundBankForFrame
units.summary: Switch to selector3 through the fixed mapper identity table before updating the banked sound engine.

units.name: FinishFrameUpdate
units.summary: Update sound, enable NMI, consume the frame-ready flag, poll controllers and update pseudo-random state once, increment the software frame counter and restore the task bank. Finally restore A/X/Y to the caller.

units.name: InstallSpriteZeroMarker
units.summary: Use A as OAM sprite0 Y, set X=$FC, tile$7E and attributes$20 for the sprite-zero split marker. This entry is separate from the localized overlapping C0BF mapper load.

units.name: UploadPendingTileRows
units.summary: When palette state and row count permit, select the requested source bank and stream width-sized rows through PPUDATA. Carry selects the address stride; the row count is bounded to its low six bits. The accepted unofficial SLO fragment remains exact bytes and is not normalized.

units.name: IrqVectorAlternateEntry
units.summary: The IRQ vector is CPU$C0C0, so this static view decodes SLO ($FF,X) exactly. The ordinary C0BC path instead has bytes B9 03 FF at C0BF (LDA $FF03,Y), overlapping these operand bytes. No IRQ fetch was observed; preserve this alternate entry without claiming normal-path execution or replacing it with the overlapping decode.

units.name: SelectTileUploadSourceBank
units.summary: The ordinary tile upload path writes the bank identity byte to the same mapper address. Its preceding LDA begins in an unknown byte at C0BF and spans the separately classified IRQ alternate entry. This source keeps exact bytes and both interpretations explicit.

units.name: ConfigureTileRowStride
units.summary: Clear the PPU address latch and select the increment mode while preserving unrelated shadow control bits.

units.name: StreamTileRows
units.summary: Set destination PPU address, stream one row, advance destination and decrement remaining rows. Fold consumed source bytes into the16-bit source pointer for the next update.

units.name: CarryTileSourcePointer
units.summary: Propagate low-byte source-pointer overflow, then return to the caller.

units.name: RunEndingMontage
units.summary: Clear the display, type FF-terminated ending text with FE line breaks and sound for nonblank tiles, then present nine room/actor setups. Each four-byte setup selects camera/room/episode, each actor list has four-byte records ending FF, and each panel queues a deferred PPU stream. Artificial route reached THE END; natural boss victory remains unproved.

units.name: TypeEndingText
units.summary: Read ending text by Y/index, stop on FF and treat FE as a new line. Nonblank tiles request sound9; queue each tile, wait12 frames and advance the16-bit PPU address.

units.name: PresentEndingPanel
units.summary: For panel0..8 load its four-byte world/room/episode record, load room resources and install its four-byte actor records. Queue the paired PPU stream, fade/display/wait/fade, clear actors and advance. After panel9 load the terminal graphics and return.

units.name: ClearEndingPanelActors
units.summary: Deactivate six actor records while preserving their other fields for subsequent initialization.

units.name: UpdateHorizontalContactOscillation
units.summary: Require active player action and narrow height/screen-X proximity to start a short global contact oscillation. Derive initial direction from relative X, tick the shared timer, probe room collision in the supported vertical band and alternate a one-unit horizontal displacement. Carry reports the contact path.

units.name: UpdateVerticalContactOscillation
units.summary: Gate on active player action, proximity and an eight-frame phase. Seed a short global oscillation timer and signed direction, probe tiles where Y is within bounds and alternate a one-unit vertical displacement. Shared state is global rather than per actor.

units.name: UpdateDynamicActors
units.summary: Visit actor slots$18/$24 at stride12. Dispatch active records through their low-six-bit type, cull them outside the camera window and clear inactive records.

units.name: DispatchDynamicActorType
units.summary: Use (type&$3F)*2 to select a little-endian word handler and jump indirectly. The37-entry directory and supported actor field contracts anchor the named handlers; the type domain is distinct from proof of natural selection.

units.name: CullOffscreenActor
units.summary: Compute a clamped left boundary camera-$18 and right boundary camera+$118. Clear the actor when its16-bit world X lies outside that interval.

units.name: ClearActorRecord
units.summary: Clear exactly the12-byte actor record selected by X, including active flag, coordinates, extents, type, attributes, pose and saved ground height.

units.name: StepPairedActorWorldPositions
units.summary: On the three frame phases where frame modulo four is nonzero, increment the first dynamic actor world X and decrement the second with explicit sixteen-bit carry and borrow. Operates on actor offsets $18 and $24. This is a coherent static helper; natural caller and actor identities remain unresolved.

units.name: MergeActorContactTypes
units.summary: Reload the current dynamic actor offset and call the two-character overlap helper, then return.

units.name: SetEpisodeEventFlagZero
units.summary: Mark persistent event flag0, face toward the player and require grounded overlap. Latch contact once, show a fallback dialog without follower or select episode/progress dialog and next-progress tables; episode3 progress2 also increments the object counter.

units.name: ReturnWithoutActorAction
units.summary: Shared dispatcher no-op handler. Return without modifying actor state; this target has an explicit type-handler contract.

units.name: DispatchEpisodeActorEvent
units.summary: Tail-dispatch one of four episode actor callbacks using a word directory. Each accepted callback has its own progress/overlap predicate; this does not imply natural selection of every state.

units.name: HandleEpisodeOneActorEvent
units.summary: Advance progress1 to2 with message2F; otherwise require player overlap and progress6 before the follower-progress7 path. The dispatch domain is episode0..3.

units.name: SetFollowerEpisodeProgress
units.summary: Require visible follower, set progress7, save actor X and mark its low-seven-bit type in the episode event bitmap before the existing continuation.

units.name: HandleEpisodeTwoActorEvent
units.summary: Advance progress4 to5 with messageB8; leave other progress states unchanged.

units.name: HandleEpisodeThreeActorEvent
units.summary: Advance progress5 to6 with messageBC; other progress states return unchanged.

units.name: HandleEpisodeFourActorEvent
units.summary: Advance progress1 to2 with messageBC; other progress states return unchanged.

units.name: SetEpisodeEventFlagTwo
units.summary: Mark event flag2, face toward player and latch grounded contact. Without follower show a frame-selected fallback; otherwise use episode dialog/next-progress tables, incrementing episode3 object progress at state7.

units.name: SetEpisodeEventFlagOne
units.summary: Mark event flag1, face toward player and latch grounded contact. Follower presence selects episode/progress dialog and state tables; episode4 has a dedicated progress4 transition and PPU stream.

units.name: HandleEpisodeFourFlagOneDialog
units.summary: At progress4 advance to5, clear the actor special flag and queue the bank4 PPU stream, then select dialog from the progress-indexed table.

units.name: SetEpisodeEventFlagThree
units.summary: Mark event flag3, face toward player and latch grounded contact. Follower presence enables the four-episode dialog/transition callbacks; otherwise show the common fallback. Some episode/progress states set the actor special bit.

units.name: SelectEpisodeOneFlagThreeDialog
units.summary: Read the dialog ID indexed by current progress and run blocking dialog; this callback is selected by the four-episode directory.

units.name: SelectEpisodeTwoFlagThreeDialog
units.summary: At progress8 advance to9, clear actor flag20 and queue the bank4 stream. Then select the dialog indexed by current progress.

units.name: SelectEpisodeThreeFlagThreeDialog
units.summary: Show the progress-indexed dialog and advance progress4 to5 or6 to7; all other progress values remain unchanged.

units.name: SelectEpisodeFourFlagThreeDialog
units.summary: Read dialog and next progress from separate progress-indexed byte tables, then store the transition result.

units.name: ReplaceActorAtProgressFour
units.summary: Only at progress4 save the actor position, mark its masked type in low-stack event storage, remove it and initialize replacement type21 in the first dynamic slot. Live stack must remain above017F.

units.name: InstallReplacementDynamicActor
units.summary: Use scratch position/type and actor offset X to copy the four-byte geometry template, set active/type flags and restore world coordinates. Template indices come from supported native replacement types.

units.name: ProbeEpisodeReplacementContact
units.summary: Probe selected actor against the player with Y zero; on contact join the existing episode replacement path, otherwise return. The fixed overlap helper has an ordinary balanced return.

units.name: DispatchEpisodeActorReplacement
units.summary: Use episode*2 to select one of four replacement callbacks. Two return immediately; the others require their exact progress state before replacing the actor.

units.name: ReturnEpisodeOneReplacement
units.summary: No replacement is performed for this episode callback.

units.name: ReplaceActorAtProgressSeven
units.summary: At progress7 mark the original low-seven-bit type, remove the actor and install type23 at its position. Low-stack event storage requires live stack above017F.

units.name: ReturnEpisodeThreeReplacement
units.summary: No replacement is performed for this episode callback.

units.name: ReplaceActorAtProgressThree
units.summary: At progress3 mark/remove the current actor and install replacement type23 at its position. Preserve the low-stack event bitmap contract.

units.name: CollectClockBonus
units.summary: Require player overlap, play pickup sound and clear actor. Add one second on each of60 frame-yield iterations, carrying into minutes and saturating at29 minutes; redraw the clock and play the tick sound.

units.name: CollectFirstBoundedCounter
units.summary: Require player overlap, remove the actor and increment counter0399 only below8, with pickup sound. Its specific item meaning remains uncertain.

units.name: CollectSecondBoundedCounter
units.summary: Require player overlap, remove the actor and increment counter039B only below8, with pickup sound. Its specific item meaning remains uncertain.

units.name: CollectEpisodeProgressObject
units.summary: Keep this actor only at supported progress1/9, require visible follower and player overlap, update progress-related counter and tail-dispatch an episode-specific action. The indirect return contract remains explicit.

units.name: ReturnEpisodeOneProgressPickup
units.summary: The episode pickup callback returns without additional action.

units.name: HandleEpisodeTwoProgressPickup
units.summary: At progress1 show messageB6, remove the actor and advance progress to2; other progress values return.

units.name: HandleEpisodeThreeProgressPickup
units.summary: Show messageB6, remove the actor and increment the episode object progress counter.

units.name: ReturnEpisodeFourProgressPickup
units.summary: The episode pickup callback returns without additional action.

units.name: CollectProgressFourObject
units.summary: On player overlap, play pickup sound, request dialog$30 and remove the actor. Advance progress4 to5 only on that exact prior value.

units.name: CollectProgressElevenObject
units.summary: On player overlap play pickup sound and remove the actor. At progress11 request dialog$BB and advance to12.

units.name: CollectEpisodeSpecificObject
units.summary: On overlap accept episode1 or3, request dialog$B9 and remove the actor. Advance progress7 to8 for episode1 or3 to4 for episode3; other cases return.

units.name: WaitForEpisodeActorSeparation
units.summary: Repeatedly test player overlap through the fixed overlap helper until carry is set, then return. Input/state progress is required for the contact loop to finish; natural selection is unresolved.

units.name: ReplaceActorAtProgressEight
units.summary: Advance progress8 to9, mark/remove the original actor and install type20 at its saved position. Require live stack above017F for the masked type bitmap write.

units.name: ProbeAlternateEpisodeReplacementContact
units.summary: Test selected actor against player and join the alternate episode replacement on contact; otherwise return. This shares the established fixed overlap interface, with no lower-bank reads in the wrapper.

units.name: ReplaceActorAtProgressEleven
units.summary: Only at progress11 mark/remove the actor and install type24 at its saved position. Low-stack event storage is separate from active return frames above017F.

units.name: FindPlayerRoomExit
units.summary: Start the shared exit search with the current player room and actor offset0.

units.name: ScanFollowerRoomExit
units.summary: Load follower room and actor offset twelve, then tail-enter the common room-exit scan. Native room directories require lower selector four; the no-match branch clears carry and returns without a mapper write. Matching exits use their own task-selector restoration.

units.name: FindActorRoomExit
units.summary: Select episode/room exit records. Each five-byte record compares a half-page world-X key and exit selector; a high-bit leading byte terminates. On a match load destination room/page/low X and dispatch player versus follower setup.

units.name: FinishPlayerRoomTransition
units.summary: Wait for dialog clearing, disable rendering and gameplay tasks, clear actor slots, install saved player spawn world X and choose entry Y. Disable dialog and join common room setup.

units.name: DeactivateActorAtY
units.summary: Clear all twelve actor record bytes beginning at active state. Caller Y is the actor stride offset; this resets the full record rather than only deactivating it.

units.name: PrepareFollowerRoomTransition
units.summary: Select the background bank before loading the follower destination record.

units.name: ApplyFollowerRoomTransition
units.summary: Set follower world X and room, then load its room-specific background/metatile/resource pointers and recompute screen X relative to the camera. Restore the current task bank at the end.

units.name: PollControllers
units.summary: Read eight serial bits from each controller, accepting either low input wire. Store held buttons and derive newly pressed buttons as new&~old. Then update the eight-byte shift-register pseudo-random state.

units.name: ReadOneController
units.summary: Strobe the serial controller latch and shift eight sampled bits into scratch. X selects the port; the result updates its held and newly pressed bytes.

units.name: AdvanceRandomState
units.summary: XOR bit1 from the first two pseudo-random bytes into carry and rotate through the eight-byte state. This deterministic generator is frame-driven.

units.name: DrawActorPose
units.summary: Choose a resource pointer from actor group and actor offset, set sprite position/attributes from its record and preserve caller X/Y around the common pose decoder.

units.name: DrawPoseAtPosition
units.summary: Accept Y/X as screen Y/X, use the indexed word pointer in the resource base and decode the pose. Hide unused trailing sprite slots if an explicit allocation limit remains.

units.name: DecodeSpriteParts
units.summary: Interpret zero as return, a positive count as that many four-byte OAM parts, and a negative lead as a nested pointer. Save high/low pointer and Y, recurse, then restore Y/low/high at D76F before continuing the parent stream.

units.name: RestoreParentSpriteStream
units.summary: Pop Y, pointer low and pointer high after the recursive sprite decoder, then continue its parent command loop. Stack order balances the three saved bytes exactly.

units.name: ReturnFromSpriteParts
units.summary: Return at the zero stream terminator. Nested callers resume through the balanced D76F restoration path.

units.name: BuildActorDrawList
units.summary: Scan the configured actor interval in12-byte steps. Include records whose active/type high bits both permit drawing, storing their ground-height sort key and actor index in parallel arrays.

units.name: SortActorDrawList
units.summary: Sort the short parallel key/index arrays by ground-height key, moving each actor index with its key. The ordering determines subsequent sprite priority.

units.name: DrawSortedActors
units.summary: Walk the sorted index list, use each actor attributes and pose to emit sprites, skip pose$FF and hide remaining sprite slots after the configured end.

units.name: SelectPaletteSet
